rics.description: Brokers & dealers loans to nonfinancial corporate business
rics.meaning: Brokers & dealers, loans to nonfinancial corporate business. Quarterly Z.1.
rics.how_to_use: Margin/securities-financing channel of corporate debt. Surges in crises (e.g., 2008 hedge fund deleveraging).

rics.description: Commercial banks holding of direct commercial paper
rics.meaning: Commercial banks holding of direct commercial paper.
rics.how_to_use: Bank participation in CP market. Watch as a money-market liquidity gauge.

rics.description: Equipment holdings, NPISH
rics.meaning: Equipment holdings, NPISH (non-profits serving households).
rics.how_to_use: Niche line; small fraction of NPISH balance sheet.

rics.description: Federal government debt securities, liability
rics.meaning: Federal government debt securities, liability — Z.1 flows.
rics.how_to_use: Quarterly issuance flow. Cross-check against Treasury auction data.

rics.description: Federal government debt securities, liability
rics.meaning: Federal government debt securities, liability — Flow of Funds Z.1 measure of total federal debt held outside Treasury (treasury securities held by the public + non-Treasury federal liabilities).
rics.how_to_use: Most-comprehensive federal-debt measure in Z.1 framework. Cross-check against Treasury Direct figures (aUSPDEBTA, aUSFEDETOS). The Z.1 includes some categories that Treasury direct excludes (FHLB, GNMA pools).

rics.description: Federal government, Retiree healthcare fund, chg at annual rate
rics.meaning: Federal retiree healthcare fund, change at annual rate.
rics.how_to_use: Niche. Small flow line.

rics.description: Federal government, retiree healthcare fund
rics.meaning: Federal retiree healthcare fund balance.
rics.how_to_use: Stock counterpart.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Balance Sheet, Household and nonprofit organizations, Net worth
rics.meaning: Household and NPO net worth — total household wealth (Z.1 B.101).
rics.how_to_use: The headline 'household wealth' number. Crashed 2008, hit ~$160T+ in 2024. Wealth-effect driver for consumption.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic financial sectors
rics.meaning: Domestic financial sectors debt outstanding (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Total leverage in financial intermediaries. Plateaued post-2008 as banks deleveraged; nonbank finance grew.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, federal government
rics.meaning: Federal government nonfinancial debt outstanding (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Component of total domestic nonfinancial debt — federal share.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, business total
rics.meaning: Domestic nonfinancial business debt total (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Sum of corporate + noncorporate. Watch debt/GDP for leverage cycle.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, business, corporate
rics.meaning: Corporate business debt outstanding (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Corporate leverage gauge. Includes loans + bonds. Hit 50%+ of GDP — historically high.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, households total
rics.meaning: Household debt total (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Mortgage + consumer credit + auto + student. ~$20T total. Debt service ratio is lower than 2008 peak.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, households, consumer credit
rics.meaning: Household consumer credit (revolving + non-revolving auto/student).
rics.how_to_use: Front-end delinquencies elevated; flagging stress in subprime credit card / auto.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, households, home mortgages
rics.meaning: Household home mortgages.
rics.how_to_use: Largest household debt category. Delinquencies low but housing market frozen at high mortgage rates.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, nonfederal, state and local government
rics.meaning: State and local government debt outstanding (Z.1).
rics.how_to_use: Munis. ~$3T total. Watch general obligation vs revenue bond mix.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Domestic nonfinancial sectors, total
rics.meaning: Total domestic nonfinancial debt (Z.1) — government + business + household.
rics.how_to_use: Master leverage gauge. >300% of GDP currently. The denominator (GDP) growth determines sustainability.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Foreign
rics.meaning: Flow of Funds Debt Outstanding, Foreign — debt instruments held by foreign sectors. Includes Treasury holdings (TIC data) plus corporate and agency debt.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks foreign claims on US debt — the financing side of US current-account deficits. Slowing foreign demand has been a Treasury concern post-2022 as China and Japan reduced Treasury holdings; partial offset from Europe.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Instruments, Federal funds and security repo, Effective federal funds rate (percent)
rics.meaning: Flow of Funds: Federal funds and security repos — total fed-funds + repo lending volumes in the financial system. Z.1 quarterly.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks unsecured (fed funds) + secured (repo) interbank lending volumes. Repo dominates post-2008 (~$5T+ daily); fed funds is small (~$100B). Stress signals: spikes in repo rates relative to IORB indicate funding pressure.

rics.description: Flow of Funds Summaries, Domestic Nonfinancial Sector, CREDIT MARKET DEBT - PRIVATE DOMESTIC NONFIN (FOF ASSET)
rics.meaning: Domestic Nonfinancial Sector — credit market debt, private domestic.
rics.how_to_use: Private credit excludes federal. Cleaner cycle gauge than total.

rics.description: Home mortgages, private domestic nonfinancial, not state & local
rics.meaning: Home mortgages, private domestic nonfinancial — total household mortgage debt outstanding. The largest household liability category.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks ~$13T household mortgage book. Growth slows sharply in housing-rate-shock periods (2022-23). Pair with mortgage-origination flows and home-price appreciation for the housing-finance cycle.

rics.description: Household sector loans to nonfinancial corporate business
rics.meaning: Household sector loans to nonfinancial corporate business.
rics.how_to_use: Niche; tracks direct lending channel.

rics.description: Nonfinancial Noncorporate Business, Assets, real estate
rics.meaning: Nonfinancial noncorporate business — real estate assets.
rics.how_to_use: CRE held outside corporate structures (sole prop, partnerships).

rics.description: Nonfinancial noncorporate business, net increase in liabilities
rics.meaning: Nonfinancial noncorporate business, net increase in liabilities.
rics.how_to_use: Smaller-business borrowing flow.

rics.description: Nonfinancial noncorporate business, net lending
rics.meaning: Nonfinancial noncorporate business, net lending position.
rics.how_to_use: Net financial position of small/private businesses.

rics.description: Policy & contract claims, life insurance
rics.meaning: Policy and contract claims, life insurance — life-insurance company liabilities to policyholders. Reflects expected future claim payouts.
rics.how_to_use: Stable balance-sheet item. Useful for tracking life-insurance industry size. Major investor in long-duration assets (Treasuries, corporates, mortgages) — track for institutional fixed-income demand patterns.

rics.description: Policy & contract claims, life insurance, chg at annual rate
rics.meaning: Policy and contract claims, life insurance, change at annual rate.
rics.how_to_use: Annualized flow.

rics.description: Total assets
rics.meaning: Total assets, all sectors — Flow of Funds Z.1 measure of total assets in the US economy. Aggregate balance-sheet wealth.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks total economy balance sheet. Used in wealth-effect calculations (consumption sensitivity to wealth changes). Most analytically useful at the household-sector subset level (separate Z.1 series).

rics.description: Treasury securities - nonfinancial business
rics.meaning: Treasury securities held by nonfinancial business.
rics.how_to_use: Corporate Treasury holdings — cash management. Surged with corporate cash piles post-2010.

rics.description: Foreign Net Treasury International Capital Flows - Actual, USD
rics.meaning: Foreign net Treasury international capital flows — actual.
rics.how_to_use: TIC data: foreign demand for US debt. Big swings move long-end yields.

rics.description: Net L-T Flows,Incl.Swaps
rics.meaning: Net long-term flows including swaps.
rics.how_to_use: Cleaner foreign demand signal stripping out short-term flows.

rics.description: Net purchases (net long-term capital inflows), total, Financial & Flow of Funds Accounts, Monthly, U.S. Department of the Treasury
rics.meaning: Net purchases (net long-term capital inflows), total.
rics.how_to_use: Headline TIC flow. Moves from policy regime shifts (e.g., China reducing UST holdings).

rics.description: Net purchases of U.S. treasury bonds & notes, total net foreign purchases, Financial & Flow of Funds Accounts, Monthly, U.S. Department of the Treasury
rics.meaning: Net foreign purchases of US Treasury bonds and notes.
rics.how_to_use: Most-watched TIC line. Persistent net buying needed to fund deficit.
